name: LYRIC (Lavender Youth Recreation & Information Center)
description: Free case management, health navigation, housing help, and workforce programs for LGBTQ+ youth
fullDescription: LYRIC provides case management, health and PrEP navigation, housing navigation, workforce and leadership programs, and community groups for LGBTQQ+ youth ages 24 and younger in San Francisco.
whatTheyOffer:
- Healthcare and PrEP navigation
- Case management
- Housing navigation (Coordinated Entry access point for youth 18-24 experiencing homelessness)
- Workforce and leadership development
- Cultural and community groups
- Drop-in youth services
howToGetIt:
1. Visit LYRIC at 127 Collingwood St (reception Mon-Fri)
2. Open to LGBTQQ+ youth ages 24 and younger
3. For housing help (ages 18-24, or 25-27 if previously served by SF homeless services), drop in weekday mornings or call the Youth Access Point at 415-322-9048
4. Register for specific programs
5. Call 415-703-6150 with questions
keywords: LYRIC, Lavender Youth, San Francisco, LGBTQ, gay, lesbian, trans, queer, youth, ages 24 and under, workforce development, PrEP navigation, HIV, housing navigation, Coordinated Entry, drop-in
